en: Multiview color postcard showing interiors and the arcaded courtyard of Hanul lui Manuc (Manuc's Inn) in Bucharest. Scenes include dining rooms, a reception area with carpets, a guest room with traditional decor, and views of the wooden balconies around the central courtyard. The front caption reads "BUCUREȘTI·HANUL MANUC." The reverse has Romanian postal layout, a Romanian stamp and cancellation, and a multilingual caption identifying the site.
